## Client Project Intake & Instant Estimate
**Form → lead score + estimate → saved → client sees estimate.**
- Public form: `/form/project-inquiry`
- Owner dashboard: `/webhook/leads-dashboard-CHANGE-ME-1` (keep this URL private)
- Leads are stored in workflow static data (active/production runs only).
- Edit rates, hours and scoring in **Score & Estimate** (RATE = 45 USD/h).
- No API keys or credentials required.

parameters.formDescription: Tell us about your project and get an instant ballpark estimate. We reply to every inquiry within one business day.
